name: desktop
description: Desktop app shell: WebUI in a native webview window (compiled WebKitGTK shim -- GTK4/webkitgtk-6.0 or GTK3/webkit2gtk-4.1, browser app-mode fallback). Serves a private local instance by default, or connects to a remote https WebUI

cli:subcommands.name: desktop
cli:subcommands.description: Open hotdog as a desktop window (local app server by default; pass https://URL to connect to a remote WebUI)
